stills.prompt: Close shot on a worn charcoal stone bench. In the foreground, two bare hands with deep warm brown skin, clearly dark brown, no face, no sleeves, grip an unfinished raw grey cast-iron five-spoke flywheel casting resting on the bench. Just behind, the worn brass-and-iron original engine from @engine, its flywheel in frame. Low-key interior: near-black stone workshop with almost no ambient light. One cool bone-white (#F5F2EB) light rakes from high left; everything else falls into black. Photorealistic, natural film grain.
